packName: NODI FR D2 curated playtest positions 11-35
purpose: Editorial source pack for Codex import into the existing NODI authoring pipeline.

notes: Editorial source only; adapt to the repository's existing production authoring schema.
Archive or supersede existing draft records occupying 11 or 21-24 according to existing revision rules; never silently delete editorial history.
Keep release loader approved-only and tester/dev access rules unchanged.
